name: Era3D Multi-View
author: Modly
description: Generates 6 consistent multi-view images from a single input image using Era3D (NeurIPS 2024). Connect between Image and Generate Mesh for dramatically improved geometry on hands, back, and thin features.

params_schema.label: Diffusion Steps
params_schema.tooltip: Number of diffusion steps. 40 is a good balance. Use 75 for highest quality on complex subjects.

params_schema.label: Guidance Scale
params_schema.tooltip: How closely the output follows the input image. 3.0 recommended for character assets.

params_schema.label: Crop Size
params_schema.tooltip: Input image crop size before feeding to Era3D. 420 works well for most character images.

params_schema.label: Output View Size
params_schema.tooltip: Resolution of each generated view. 512px gives the best geometry when fed into Trellis2.
